title: Full Moon in Aquarius
tldr: A culmination and release point for the Aquarius / Leo axis.
theme: This Full Moon illuminates future vision, community, individuation, innovation, and the courage to belong without disappearing through the Aquarius side of the axis, while the Sun in Leo asks for integration rather than extremes.
shadow: detachment disguised as enlightenment, rebellion without responsibility, or selling a version of yourself you do not believe in
integration: changing the system without abandoning your own aliveness

twoWeekArc.teaching: Your people want the real version, not the polished version built for approval.
twoWeekArc.appPrompt: Name what the last two weeks revealed. Release the pattern that blocks the Aquarius / Leo balance point.

sixMonthArc.appPrompt: Look back to the same-sign New Moon. What took root because you tended it, and what grew because the soil was left untended?

ritual.function: illumination, release, cleansing, integration, and completion
ritual.timing: Use after the exact Full Moon when possible. Keep eclipse lunations under the separate witness protocol, not ordinary release ritual.
ritual.materials: Saturn kamea, black tourmaline, salt, elm, feather, candle, and water.
ritual.simpleSubstitution: A white candle, water, paper, and a quiet place are enough.
ritual.action: Write what is complete, what is ready to be released, and how the higher expression of Aquarius can be embodied without rejecting Leo.

journalPrompt: What am I ready to release from the shadow of Aquarius, and what balance with Leo is asking to be lived now?
tarotPrompt: What truth is this Aquarius Full Moon revealing that I can no longer avoid?
